B: official platform documentation and architecture research
C: durable user feedback and field evidence through R76

scoring.note: This is an engineering maturity score against the full A+B+C capability matrix, not a claim that every individual requirement is equally difficult.

requirements.title: Canonical project identity, HEAD, append-only events and checkpoint
requirements.gap: Field recovery across all projects remains incomplete.

requirements.title: Structured allowlisted jobs with schema, idempotency, fencing and expiry
requirements.gap: Not every adapter uses the full contract end-to-end.

requirements.title: Machine receipts, artifacts, hashes and proof-carrying claims
requirements.gap: Coverage varies by adapter and field path.

requirements.title: Universal offline OUTBOX/INBOX on phone and PC
requirements.gap: Phone queue exists; universal cross-adapter PC+phone semantics are not fully field-proven.

requirements.title: Capability Registry and capability-aware routing
requirements.gap: Capabilities exist in several surfaces but are not yet one complete runtime registry.

requirements.title: Global recovery pointer and cold conversation takeover
requirements.gap: Durable takeover works structurally but communication closeout drift showed incomplete enforcement.

requirements.title: Local-first survival across Internet, power and PC reboot
requirements.gap: Real power-cut and multi-day partition gates remain open.

requirements.title: CORE separated from project/service adapters
requirements.gap: Repository still contains adapter-specific coupling that needs a formal core interface.

requirements.title: Thin cloud coordination, not bulk authority
requirements.gap: Tenant/Project coordination model from preconception is not fully realized.

requirements.title: Approval lanes, least privilege, no arbitrary shell, external content as data
requirements.gap: Field validation of all R2/R3 mappings remains incomplete.

requirements.title: Explicit RAM/CPU/battery/network/storage/cloud budgets with graceful degradation
requirements.gap: Budgets are not yet unified across every worker and adapter.

requirements.title: Unified human cockpit for projects, blockers, evidence and next action
requirements.gap: No single mature cross-project cockpit is field-qualified.

requirements.title: Retention plus portable export/migration JSONL+SQLite+manifest
requirements.gap: No full export/import round-trip evidence.

requirements.title: Reusable multi-project adapters across PhoneMouse, BuildHub, P2PCR95 and future projects
requirements.gap: Several projects are referenced, but adapter parity is incomplete.

requirements.title: Minimum human handoff: user is not telemetry bus
requirements.gap: Recent communication and install loops prove manual friction still exists.

requirements.title: Dedicated old phone becomes primary low-power Edge/API appliance, not accessory
requirements.gap: 2.2 full-node is candidate, not field-promoted.

requirements.title: Optional fully-managed/Device-Owner appliance mode for truly dedicated phone
requirements.gap: DPC/device-owner provisioning path not implemented or field-tested.

requirements.title: Authenticated phone-hosted local API server with status/context/sync/jobs/capabilities
requirements.gap: Field install still runs older 2.1.2 line.

requirements.title: Multi-transport local discovery and fallback: LAN/NSD, hotspot, Wi-Fi Direct, BLE presence
requirements.gap: Transport selection/failover needs real phone-PC field qualification.

requirements.title: Exploit dedicated 64GB storage with adaptive reserve instead of fixed small cache
requirements.gap: Current cap is 8GiB, materially underusing a dedicated 64GB node.

requirements.title: Phone durable operational memory with layered current/history/policy state
requirements.gap: Layered memory exists but long-horizon indexing/search and recovery tests are incomplete.

requirements.title: Useful phone-side deterministic executor while PC is absent
requirements.gap: Only four maintenance/snapshot tasks are currently supported.

requirements.title: Phone-first communication broker and provider-proof store-and-forward
requirements.gap: Telegram field relay is not registered in installed 2.1.2 and Gmail is not phone-native.

requirements.title: Encrypted/pinned local API transport beyond cleartext LAN bearer
requirements.gap: usesCleartextTraffic=true and HTTP local API remain; target needs TLS/pinned pairing or equivalent authenticated encryption.

requirements.title: Boot restoration, foreground server and durable maintenance scheduling
requirements.gap: OEM-specific background survival still needs target-phone field evidence.

requirements.title: Power-loss-aware SQLite durability policy and bounded WAL checkpointing
requirements.gap: Critical-table durability classes and real abrupt-power-loss tests are not closed.

requirements.title: Fast on-device memory search/index for context reconstruction
requirements.gap: Need explicit FTS/index strategy and bounded retrieval proof.

requirements.title: Phone as recovery replica and continuity authority when PC is offline
requirements.gap: EDGE_ONLY is useful but not yet able to advance enough project/control operations independently.

requirements.title: Server-grade phone UI: node health, projects, queue, communications, storage, transports, permissions, recovery
requirements.gap: Candidate UI is not yet visually/field qualified as a coherent appliance cockpit.

requirements.title: No micro-beta install loop; release only coherent integrated candidate
requirements.gap: Must remain enforced through signing/Drive field promotion.

requirements.title: Simulate representative PC/Android path before asking user to click/install
requirements.gap: Physical/OEM-only behaviors remain irreducibly field-bound.

requirements.title: 25-minute tranche: START, ~23 min useful work, 2 min close, END provider proof, then pointer
requirements.gap: R76 is first tranche on corrected cadence; field/process proof still pending.

requirements.title: Project-labeled Gmail START/END detailed checkpoints
requirements.gap: Need normal-primary END reliability without recovery guards.

requirements.title: Telegram resilient witness/secondary cockpit with phone relay fallback
requirements.gap: Current field Telegram direct transport outage and inactive installed phone relay.

requirements.title: Stop underusing the dedicated old phone; shift durable low-power duties off PC
requirements.gap: 2.2 candidate is a large step but field system is still 2.1.2 and PC remains too central.

requirements.title: Minimize mobile-data cost and operate over weak/variable RDC connectivity
requirements.gap: Need measured data budgets and field failover receipts.

requirements.title: Professional, comprehensible phone UI matching full server functions
requirements.gap: Installed UI feedback remains negative; visual acceptance matrix not closed.

requirements.title: Cold new conversation resumes without re-explaining communication/project rules
requirements.gap: Needs fresh-chat proof after R76 cadence/spec update.

requirements.title: Zero-dollar, weak-PC, unstable-power architecture remains usable and self-healing
requirements.gap: End-to-end field endurance/chaos acceptance is still open.
